title: Wire exit-time Dolt checkpoint into the CLI graceful close
description: The CLI 'loreweaver play' graceful close calls closeSessionGracefully without a SessionCheckpointRunner, so session exit runs scene-summary/recap/arc-rollup but no Dolt checkpoint. closeSessionGracefully already accepts an optional checkpoint runner; this issue wires one (Dolt provisioning + CheckpointStore) into runPlay's close path so exit-time checkpoints happen.
acceptance_criteria: loreweaver play graceful exit passes a SessionCheckpointRunner to closeSessionGracefully; a Dolt checkpoint is created on clean exit; absence of Dolt degrades gracefully (clear message, session still closes); the CLI reports the checkpoint id.
close_reason: Work merged to main via PR #13 (3bf32b2) and PR #14 (efdf91c); issues left in_progress.
